About.title: An agile travel concierge, built around your ambitions
About.p1: Based in Levallois-Perret, Travel Business Agency designs and orchestrates high-end travel experiences for companies and discerning individuals alike.
About.p2: From chartering a private jet to organising a seminar, an event or a fully bespoke journey, we handle every detail with the responsiveness of an agile team and the standards of a true service house.

Services.subtitle: From the first idea to the last mile, we manage the whole chain with precision and responsiveness.

SurMesure.metaTitle: Tailor-made travel and destinations — Travel Business Agency
SurMesure.metaDescription: Tailor-made travel with Travel Business Agency: how it works, destinations, moods, and a quote. The agency's own signature itineraries are still to be written.
SurMesure.title: A destination, a pace, then the journey.
SurMesure.lede: Tailor-made travel starts with you: the season, the number of nights, what must stay free. The pages that follow give the facts of a destination. They are not a catalogue of dated departures.
SurMesure.whyTitle: The same guarantees as the rest of the house

one.title: One person
one.text: One contact follows the project, from the first request to the return.

two.title: IATA and APST
two.text: The agency is IATA-accredited. Deposits are covered by the APST guarantee.

three.title: The pace
three.text: Nothing is stacked to fill a week. A departure city or a layover is not a destination.

SurMesure.signatureText: The itineraries the agency will want to sign. The places are ready. The facts are not, yet.

DestinationsHub.metaDescription: Tailor-made destinations, grouped by continent: the Indian Ocean, Asia, Europe, Africa, the Americas, the Pacific.
DestinationsHub.title: Choose the place first, then the pace
DestinationsHub.lede: Sixteen destinations, set by continent. Each page says when to go, what one comes for, a travel idea, and the practical facts from Paris.

DestinationPage.metaDescription: Tailor-made travel in {name}: season, ways to stay, a sense of the flight from Paris, time difference and entry rules. No invented price.
DestinationPage.practicalNote: Orders of magnitude and entry rules for a French passport, at the time of writing. Rules change. The agency checks them again before departure.

ThemesPage.metaDescription: Honeymoon, safari, islands, road trip, culture, the far north: ways into the destinations.
ThemesPage.title: Enter by the mood, arrive at a destination
ThemesPage.lede: Six moods. Each one leads to destinations in the catalogue, and nothing else.

ThemePage.metaDescription: Destinations for {name}, in the Travel Business Agency tailor-made catalogue.

Voyages.metaDescription: Signature itineraries by Travel Business Agency, shaped to you. The journey catalogue is still being written.
Voyages.title: An itinerary the agency holds, then adjusts for you
Voyages.lede: A signature journey starts from a frame: destination, length, season, pace, then the days. Nothing is fixed. The catalogue below waits for the journeys the agency chooses to show.

destination.title: The destination
destination.text: The cities where you stay. Not the city you leave from, and not a layover.

rhythm.title: The pace
rhythm.text: The number of nights, the tempo of the days, what stays free.

days.title: The days
days.text: Each day has a title and what happens, only when it is known.

adjust.title: The adjustment
adjust.text: The frame is taken up with you: dates, number of travellers, wishes.

Voyages.catalogueText: Four places. Each field stays empty until the journey is written.

VoyageDetail.metaDescription: Frame of a Travel Business Agency signature journey. The facts of the trip are still to be written.
VoyageDetail.title: Signature journey {slot}
VoyageDetail.lede: This page is the frame of an itinerary. The facts, the price and the promises are not written yet.
VoyageDetail.daysText: Three days are placed to show the shape. Their content is still to be written, and the list grows with the journey.
VoyageDetail.bespokeText: Dates, number of travellers, rooms, tables, pace. Nothing in this frame is a firm offer.

AppPage.metaTitle: The TBA app — Travel Business Agency
AppPage.metaDescription: The Travel Business Agency client space: hotels, the trip record, documents, boarding passes and transactions. A web app, with no store listing yet.
AppPage.title: The space where the trip is held
AppPage.lede: TBA is the agency's client space, opened in the browser. Members book hotels at reserved rates, follow the journey, and find their documents.

hotels.title: Hotels
hotels.text: A hotel catalogue at rates reserved for you, with benefits you do not find on a direct booking. The request goes to the agency, the confirmation is followed in the same place, and cancellation is possible when the rate allows it.

stay.title: The trip record
stay.text: The bookings of the stay: flights, hotels, transfers and the rest of the itinerary, in one place.

papers.title: Documents
papers.text: Trip documents and boarding passes live in the space, not in another tool.

ledger.title: Transactions
ledger.text: The client account and the movements of the stay are read in the space.

AppPage.clubTitle: Four levels, shown inside the space
AppPage.clubPromise: A hotel catalogue at rates reserved for you, with benefits you do not find on a direct booking.

silver.name: Silver
silver.line: Up to 10% off the catalogue, early arrival and late departure.

gold.name: Gold
gold.line: Up to 15% off the catalogue, and an upgrade when a room is free.

platinum.name: Platinum
platinum.line: Up to 20% off the catalogue, breakfast, a hotel credit of up to $200, and an airport transfer.

titanium.name: Titanium
titanium.line: Up to 25% off the catalogue, concierge, VIP welcome and pre-registration.

AppPage.clubNote: These amounts and benefits are the ones shown in the client space. The product's asterisk remains: subject to availability and to the hotel. Hotel access is opened by the agency.
AppPage.accessText: Entry is by invitation, then a password or a magic link, on travelba.fr. On a phone, the space can be added to the home screen: it is the same application, full screen.
AppPage.stores: There is no iOS or Android application on the App Store or Google Play. When one exists, the link will be here.

FamilyPage.metaDescription: Family stays composed by Travel Business Agency: palaces and children's clubs. The addresses the agency keeps are still to be named.
FamilyPage.title: The journey follows the children's pace
FamilyPage.lede: A family stay is drawn like a tailor-made journey: the hotel, the rooms, the children's club, the transfers. The houses named below are inspiration, not partners of the agency.
FamilyPage.imageAlt: A palace pool by the water
FamilyPage.composeText: The palace or the villa, the transfer, the welcome on arrival, and the children's day. The addresses TBA keeps for families are not published yet.
FamilyPage.inspirationTitle: Three children's clubs, to give a sense of the level
FamilyPage.inspirationText: Public facts from the houses, November 2026. No TBA rate, no exclusive agreement.

soneva.name: Soneva Fushi
soneva.fact: The Den welcomes children and teenagers from 4 to 17. Access and the daily programme are included in the stay, with a team present. Under 4, childcare is requested separately.

reethi.name: One&Only Reethi Rah
reethi.fact: KidsOnly is the club for ages 4 to 12, open every day. One Tribe is for ages 13 to 17. Babysitting exists, on request.

borabora.name: Four Seasons Resort Bora Bora
borabora.fact: The Kids For All Seasons programme is held at Tamarii Club, for ages 5 to 12, on weekends and holidays, with a dedicated team.

FamilyPage.selectionText: The list of resorts TBA offers families, and what it adds there, is still to be written.
